## Primary Request and Intent
- Develop a DSH “滑词对话” plugin (`dsh-clipchat`): select text in a DSH assistant reply, get a floating card near the selection, ask/follow up without polluting the main message flow, with token transparency and optional “带回主线”.
- Original doc: `/workspace/dsh-clipchat/dsh-clipchat-需求文档.md`; user asked to read it, refine the plan, and modify unreasonable parts.
- Later requirements evolved:
  - “滑词的位置在当前session应该永久保留，有点类似于微信公众号文章的滑词一样。归档或删除掉会话后，该滑词也同步清理。然后后台存储默认保留7天吧。”
  - “没有进行交互的情况下，你不应该出现滑词展示的… 不是用户滑了就展示，而是滑了，并且进行了交互才展示”
  - “滑词里也要支持用户选择模型的”
  - “我滑词后，应该光标自动聚焦到输入框，而不是还需要用户手动点一下”
  - “点击空白的地方、按ESC、或者点x，都可以关闭掉这个对话框”
  - Final: `/ask-matt` + “好的，原型已经确认，接下来该干什么”

## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH 0.2.2-rc.3, runtime `/home/user/.dsh/runtime/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`.
- Client UI plugin: `ctx.uiConversation.interactions.register({id,onInteraction})` + keyed slot `conversation.chat.text-interaction`; `id` is the slot key; owner props `trigger/readText/dismiss/clearSelection`; session props `sessionId/useChat/inputActions`, etc.; `open()` only during synchronous dispatch.
- Host half: `webServer.register({kind:'exact'|'prefix',path,handler})` + SSE + `ctx.llm.stream`; no hidden session needed.
- Route guard: `ctx.connection.requestRejection(req)` (401/403, Host/Origin/cookie), preferred over hand-written token. Tailscale domain already in `trustedHosts`.
- Model resolution host-side: `sessions.get(sessionId)?.requestHeader()?.config` → `agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` → capture last `llm/stream`; else 503.
- Assistant history MUST use `createAssistantMessage({content, source:{provider, model}})`, not bare `{role:'assistant'}` (reads `message.source.replayState`; otherwise TypeError → `finish{kind:'error'}`).
- `ctx.llm.stream` chunks: `text-delta`, `reasoning-delta`, `usage {inputTokens,outputTokens,...}`, terminal `finish{kind:'stop'|'error'|'aborted'}`; abort via `signal` + `res.on('close')`.
- Highlight anchoring model: session-scoped records, `messageId/block + character offsets`; DOM marks via TreeWalker; `normalize()` after unwrap.
- Real model IDs: `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash), `deepseek-v4-pro` (DeepSeek-V4-Pro).
- Session lifecycle: host event `'workspace/session-archived'`; archive/delete cleanup; 7-day TTL.
- Local markdown wayfinder tracker; repo has no git.

## Files and Code
- `/workspace/dsh-clipchat/.scratch/dsh-clipchat/map.md`
  - Wayfinder map; Destination includes highlights; Notes list prototype baseline `prototype/session-highlights.html` (v2 confirmed), v1 for comparison.
  - Decisions-so-far: 01, 02, 03, 08.
- `/workspace/dsh-clipchat/.scratch/dsh-clipchat/issues/`
  - `01-freeze-m1-product-decisions.md` — resolved: M1 includes follow-up; default context = selection + whole message + 2-3 recent turns; assistant-only; window disposable / 留痕 persisted; follow main model + token; back-to-main = quote + summary.
  - `02-verify-dsh-apis.md` — resolved; findings in research file.
  - `03-prototype-floating-card.md` — **resolved**; v2 interaction baseline: selection only opens card + auto-focus, explicit ask/“高亮这段” commits, assistant-only, model picker, close blank/Esc/X.
  - `04-context-assembly.md` — open, blocked by 09.
  - `05-history-record-model.md` — open; partial: session-level list + current-selection tag; Q&A only on 留痕.
  - `06-back-to-main-contract.md` — open, blocked by 09.
  - `07-m1-implementation-spec.md` — open; blocked by 03,04,05,06,09,10.
  - `08-floating-surface-path.md` — resolved: path A (host text-interaction) + smoke gate.
  - `09-text-interaction-smoke.md` — open, frontier; task: minimal real plugin proving popover, props, 2 questions, locale/t.
  - `10-highlight-persistence.md` — open; partial: explicit commit trigger; model picker per highlight; remaining TTL/archive/anchoring/storage.
- `/workspace/dsh-clipchat/.scratch/dsh-clipchat/research/dsh-api-findings.md`
  - 338-line primary-source research with line numbers; three premise corrections; M1 call skeleton.
- `/workspace/dsh-clipchat/.scratch/dsh-clipchat/prototype/session-highlights.html`
  - v2 single-file prototype, confirmed.
  - localStorage key `clipchat:v2:demo-session`; 7-day TTL (`TTL = 7 * DAY`), block/char offset spans, `unwrapAll()` + `block.normalize()`, pending selection state, model menu, session menu.
- `/workspace/dsh-clipchat/.scratch/dsh-clipchat/prototype/floating-card.html` and `floating-card-v1.html`
  - v1 A/B/C comparison; kept for reference.
- Reference plugin clones: `/tmp/clipchat-refs/` (`dsh-select-ask`, `dsh-minichat`, `dsh-bubble-explain`, `dsh-sidenote`).
- Symlinks for testing: `/tmp/clipchat-prototype.html`, `/tmp/clipchat-v2.html`.

## Errors and Fixes
- v1 card positioned at viewport top-left: `#surfaceHost` was outside `.chat`; moved inside to get correct containing block.
- Composer white dash: `.composer .draft { display:flex }` overrode `[hidden]`; added `[hidden]{display:none!important}`.
- Textarea white scrollbar: default `overflow:auto` with `scrollH 31 > clientH 30`; set `overflow:hidden`.
- Card covered composer: capped `max-height:300px` and clamped against composer top.
- v2 restored turns missing `status`: persisted turns lack `status`; `loadState` now maps `turns.map(t => ({...t, status:'done'}))`.
- v2 pending flow: removed broken `createHighlight(text,spans)` wrapper that passed `range=null`; mouseup now clones range, clears selection, calls `showPending(text, spans, cloned)`.
- Repeated `applyAll` split marks: added `b.normalize()` after unwrapping.
- Test confusion: selecting an already-highlighted passage activates the existing highlight (dup path), not pending; expected.
- v1 B-variant screenshot surprise: user was concurrently clicking the switcher, not a bug.

## Pending Jobs
- Run ticket 09 smoke: minimal real plugin, verify selection popover, `sessionId/useChat/inputActions`, locale/t existence, 2-turn ask without TypeError.
- Resolve ticket 05 remaining: storage location (host JSON/localStorage), fields, retention cap, auto-record vs manual.
- Resolve ticket 10 remaining: TTL semantics (inactivity 7d vs creation 7d), archive cleanup vs reversible, anchoring model, host vs local storage.
- Resolve tickets 04/06 after 09.
- Produce ticket 07 M1 spec.
- Then `/to-spec` → `/to-tickets` → `/implement` (or `/implement-spec`).

## Current Work
- Just marked ticket 03 resolved (user confirmed v2), appended its answer and updated map Decisions-so-far with ticket 03 and the v2 prototype baseline.
- Preparing the `/ask-matt` answer: next is ticket 09 smoke, not implementation.

## Next Step
- Answer `/ask-matt`: run ticket 09 smoke next; resolve 05/10 in parallel; after the map clears, invoke `/to-spec` → `/to-tickets` → `/implement` per ticket. Recommend `/compact` at this prototype→smoke phase boundary (same directory/harness; `/handoff` not needed).

## Critical Context
- Workspace path has a trailing space: `/workspace/dsh-clipchat`.
- No git repo; never commit/branch unless asked.
- Path A (host text-interaction) chosen with smoke gate; fallback B = custom selection + `shell.overlay` (all three reference plugins use B; none uses text-interaction).
- Highlights persist per session; archive/delete clears; 7-day TTL currently implemented as last-access/inactivity; user has not confirmed hard-7d vs inactivity.
- Q&A persists only on “留痕”; highlight itself persists after explicit commit; session-level list with “当前选段” tag.
- Model picker is per highlight; default “跟随主会话”; real list should come from `ctx.llm.listModels`/profile.
- Auto-focus after selection; clicking existing highlight to read does not steal focus; only new/duplicate selection focuses.
- Close on blank pointerdown / Esc / X; click inside card and highlight marks excluded; menu Esc closes menu first.
- User preferences: Chinese, conclusion first, concise, GenUI allowed for structured content, `~` written as `-`, teaching mode 🟢 学一招 on, safety red lines.
- `/to-spec`, `/to-tickets`, `/implement` are `disable-model-invocation: true` — user must invoke.
- Ask-matt flow: wayfinder hands off to `/to-spec` when map clears; do not jump straight to `/implement`.
- Context is long; phase-boundary guidance favors `/compact` over `/handoff` (no new harness/directory/colleague).
